articles.title_en: Multi-Product Pricing: Theory and Evidence from Large Retailers
articles.title_cn: 多产品定价：来自大型零售商的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We study a unique dataset with comprehensive coverage of daily prices in large multi-product retailers in Israel. Retail stores synchronise price changes around occasional ‘peak’ days when they reprice around 10% of their products. To assess aggregate implications of partial price synchronisation, we develop a new model in which multi-product firms face economies of scope in price adjustment, and synchronisation is endogenous. Synchronisation of price changes attenuates the average price response to monetary shocks, but only high degrees of synchronisation can substantially strengthen the real effects of monetary policy shocks. Our calibrated model generates real effects similar in magnitude to those in M. Golosov, and R.E. Lucas, Journal of Political Economy (2007), vol. 115, pp. 171–99.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个独特的数据集，该数据集全面覆盖了以色列大型多产品零售商的每日价格。零售商店在偶尔的“高峰”日同步调整价格，在这些日子里，它们对约10%的产品重新定价。为了评估部分价格同步的总体影响，我们开发了一个新模型，在该模型中，多产品企业面临价格调整的范围经济，且同步是内生的。价格变化的同步减弱了平均价格对货币冲击的响应，但只有高度同步才能显著增强货币政策冲击的实际效应。我们的校准模型产生的实际效应与M. Golosov和R.E. Lucas在《政治经济学杂志》（2007年）第115卷，第171-99页中的结果在数量级上相似。

articles.title_en: International Trade and Innovation Dynamics with Endogenous Markups
articles.title_cn: 内生加成率下的国际贸易与创新动态
articles.abstract_en: We argue that the recent increases in market concentration and markups are partly due to an ‘innovation feedback effect’ of globalisation. Lower trade costs increase innovation incentives for global firms. As the winners of the ensuing innovation race increase their technological advantage, concentration and markups rise. We develop an endogenous growth model capturing this effect and calibrate it to US manufacturing data. We find that the increase in trade between 1989 and 2007 raised the aggregate markup by 3.5 percentage points. This is entirely due to innovation: without the innovation response, markups would have fallen by 4 percentage points.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们认为，近期市场集中度和加成率的上升部分归因于全球化的“创新反馈效应”。贸易成本的降低增加了全球企业的创新激励。随着随后的创新竞赛中的赢家扩大其技术优势，集中度和加成率上升。我们构建了一个内生增长模型来捕捉这一效应，并将其校准至美国制造业数据。我们发现，1989年至2007年间贸易的增长使总体加成率提高了3.5个百分点。这完全归因于创新：如果没有创新响应，加成率本会下降4个百分点。

articles.title_en: Identification and Parametric Estimation of Empirical Dynamic Marriage Matching Models
articles.title_cn: 经验动态婚姻匹配模型的识别与参数估计
articles.abstract_en: Marriage matching markets typically involve heterogenous agents participating in a dynamic, non-stationary environment. These features pose a considerable modelling challenge. In this paper, we develop a new parametric model of dynamic marriage that allows for market non-stationarity using a system of transitionary equilibria. We propose a method to identify and parametrically estimate the model by representing the model equilibrium with a fixed-point mapping. We apply our model to investigate how China’s one-child policy has affected the marriage distribution through its effect on the population and sex ratios.
articles.abstract_cn: 婚姻匹配市场通常涉及异质性参与者在动态、非平稳环境中的互动。这些特征构成了相当大的建模挑战。在本文中，我们开发了一个新的动态婚姻参数模型，该模型通过一系列过渡均衡来允许市场非平稳性。我们提出了一种通过将模型均衡表示为不动点映射来识别和参数估计该模型的方法。我们应用我们的模型来研究中国的独生子女政策如何通过其对人口和性别比例的影响影响婚姻分布。

articles.title_en: Coordinated Work Schedules and the Gender Wage Gap
articles.title_cn: 协调工作安排与性别工资差距
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how coordinated work schedules across jobs contribute to the gender wage gap. Using US time diary data, we construct occupation-level measures of coordinated schedules. Higher coordination is associated with higher wages and a larger gender wage gap. Empirically, women with children allocate more time to household care and are penalised for missing work during peak hours. An equilibrium occupational choice model generates a gender wage gap of 8.9%; most of the gender wage gap is within occupations. If coordination is set to the value of healthcare support across all occupations, the within-occupation gender gap halves.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究跨工作的协调工作安排如何导致性别工资差距。利用美国时间日记数据，我们构建了职业层面的协调安排指标。更高的协调性与更高的工资和更大的性别工资差距相关。实证上，有子女的女性将更多时间分配给家庭照料，并因在高峰时段缺勤而受到惩罚。一个均衡的职业选择模型产生了8.9%的性别工资差距；大部分性别工资差距存在于职业内部。如果将协调性设定为所有职业中医疗保健支持的值，职业内部的性别差距将减半。

articles.title_en: The Emperor’s Geography—City Locations, Nature and Institutional Optimisation
articles.title_cn: 皇帝的疆域——城市区位、自然条件与制度优化
articles.abstract_en: The emergence of cities in specific locations depends on both geographical features (such as elevation and proximity to rivers) and institutional factors (such as centrality within an administrative region). In this paper, we analyse the importance of these factors at different levels of the urban hierarchy. To do so, we exploit a unique data set on the locations of cities of different status in imperial China from 221 BCE to 1911 CE, a geographically diverse empire with a long history of centralised rule. Developing a stylised theoretical model, we combine econometrics with machine learning techniques. Our results suggest that the higher a city is in the urban hierarchy, the less important are local geographical features compared to institutional factors. At the lower end of the scale, market towns without government responsibilities are most strongly shaped by geographical characteristics. We also find evidence that many cities of political importance in imperial times still enjoy a special status nowadays, underlining the modern relevance of these historical factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 特定区位的城市的出现既取决于地理特征（如海拔和与河流的邻近性），也取决于制度因素（如在行政区域内的中心性）。在本文中，我们分析了这些因素在城市层级不同水平上的重要性。为此，我们利用了公元前221年至公元1911年间中华帝国不同地位城市区位的独特数据集，这是一个地理多样且具有悠久中央集权统治历史的帝国。通过开发一个程式化的理论模型，我们将计量经济学与机器学习技术相结合。我们的结果表明，城市在城市层级中越高，当地地理特征相对于制度因素的重要性就越低。在规模的低端，没有政府职责的集镇受地理特征的影响最为强烈。我们还发现证据表明，帝国时期许多具有政治重要性的城市至今仍享有特殊地位，这凸显了这些历史因素的现代相关性。

articles.title_en: Auctions with Privately Known Capacities: Understanding Competition Among Renewables
articles.title_cn: 具有私人已知容量的拍卖：理解可再生能源之间的竞争
articles.abstract_en: We study a multi-unit auction model in which bidders are privately informed about the maximum number of units they are willing to trade (which we refer to as ‘capacity’). No matter how big or small, private information on capacities changes the nature of the equilibrium as compared to when private information is on costs (or valuations). Also, the uniform-price and discriminatory auctions are not revenue equivalent, in contrast to when costs are independently drawn. In particular, with independently drawn capacities (and possibly costs), the discriminatory format reduces payments to firms relative to the uniform-price format. Our analysis is motivated by the performance of future electricity markets in which renewable energies will be predominant, but the set-up also applies to a variety of contexts (from central bank liquidity auctions to emissions trading).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个多单位拍卖模型，其中竞标者私下知道他们愿意交易的最大单位数量（我们称之为“容量”）。无论大小，关于容量的私人信息都会改变均衡的性质，与私人信息是关于成本（或估值）的情况相比。此外，统一价格拍卖和歧视性拍卖在收入上并不等价，这与成本独立抽取的情况形成对比。特别是，在容量（可能还有成本）独立抽取的情况下，歧视性格式相对于统一价格格式减少了向企业的支付。我们的分析受到未来电力市场表现的启发，其中可再生能源将占主导地位，但该设置也适用于多种情境（从中央银行流动性拍卖到排放交易）。

articles.title_en: Multi-Dimensional Skills and Gender Differences in STEM Majors
articles.title_cn: 多维技能与STEM专业中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the relationship between pre-college skills and gender differences in STEM majors. I use longitudinal data to estimate a generalised Roy model of initial major choices and subsequent graduation outcomes. I recover students’ latent math ability, non-cognitive skills and math self-efficacy. High–math-ability women have lower math self-efficacy than men. Mathematical ability and self-efficacy shape the likelihood of STEM enrolment. A lack of math self-efficacy drives women’s drop out from STEM majors. I find large returns to STEM enrolment for high–math-ability women. Well-focused math self-efficacy interventions could improve women’s STEM graduation rates and labour market outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大学前技能与STEM专业性别差异之间的关系。我使用纵向数据估计了一个关于初始专业选择和后续毕业结果的广义罗伊模型。我恢复了学生的潜在数学能力、非认知技能和数学自我效能。高数学能力的女性比男性具有更低的数学自我效能。数学能力和自我效能塑造了STEM入学的可能性。数学自我效能的缺乏导致女性从STEM专业退学。我发现高数学能力女性在STEM入学方面有较大的回报。有针对性的数学自我效能干预措施可以提高女性的STEM毕业率和劳动力市场结果。
